# A01-S66: Yuk Hui

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

I have just read the attached, a brand new article by Yuk Hui, who is a Chinese computer scientist who has become a recognized continental European philosopher.

He expands among other things the definitions of intelligence by including the Chinese response to Immanuel Kant’s philosophy.

Thought it is right down your alley, but from a different angle.

I have not started the book about law and robots yet, but it is next on the list.
